verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a REST API for requesting signatures (docusign-docs-21) and an official Node client to send, sign and approve documents (docusign-docs-40). Hands-on reports describe building production integrations quickly (docusign-comm-4, docusign-comm-5). It also ships an official MCP server (docusign-probe-3) with a supported Claude connector (docusign-docs-39) that can trigger workflow actions and query agreement status (docusign-docs-47), so an agent can route an agreement for signature. However, AI drafting and dynamic templates are documented only as CLM/UI features (docusign-docs-41), not as API- or MCP-driven generation. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP-driven NDA drafting or template generation, an explicit MCP tool for creating and sending envelopes, an end-to-end agent walkthrough from draft to signature.
